    EVENT 3 · NEW BRAWLERS

    Six new rule-breakers

    4

    EVENT 4 · TRAINING CAVE

    What did you do?

    A question word goes in front of Did. The past stays in did, so the verb stays normal.

    Yes / no question

    Didyougo to the pool?
    DidMaxcome at six?

    Short answer: Yes, I did. / No, he didn't.

    Wh- question

    Wheredidyougo?
    Whatdidyoudo on Saturday?
    Whodidyouplay with?
    WhendidMaxcome?

    Say a sentence: I went to the pool. I played chess. With Leo. At six.

    The question word goes first

    Where + did + you + go?

    Then everything is the same as Did you go?

    One past is enough

    What did you do? (not did)

    The past is in did. The verb stays normal.

    Four question words

    What = things · Where = places
    Who = people · When = time

    Who did you play with? (with at the end)

    Don't say What did you did? → What did you do?Where you went? → Where did you go?Who did you played with? → Who did you play with?
    • What did you do on Saturday? I played chess with Leo.
    • Where did Dan go? He went to the cinema.
    • Who did Rosie swim with? She swam with Nora.
    • When did you get up? I got up at nine.

    EVENT 5 · READING

    Leo's weekend

    First the weekend words, then Leo's post. Then answer the questions.

    Leo's Weekend Report

    Sunday, 8.45 pm

    The best weekend of the autumn

    by Leo

    On Saturday morning I had a swimming competition. I swam very fast and I came second! Then I went home and Max came to my house at eleven. We played chess, and I won two games.

    After lunch we went to the cinema with Dan. Dan took his little sister Nora too. The film was funny, and Nora laughed all the time.

    On Sunday I stayed at home in the morning and slept until ten. Then I visited my grandparents. My grandma gave me a big chocolate cake. I said "Thank you!" and ate three pieces. In the evening I met Max in the park and we walked my dog Rex. I put my phone in my bag, and I didn't play Brawl Stars all day. What a weekend!

    Listen
